insights.one_liner: British health and hygiene company behind Dettol and Durex, an IND recognised sponsor with an entry-level role at Schiphol.

culture.text: A British health and hygiene company with brands like Dettol and Durex.
Its open entry-level healthcare and life sciences job is based at Schiphol.

open.text: Reckitt Benckiser (ENA) B.V. and Reckitt Benckiser Healthcare B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
Its open role here needs no Dutch.
The Dutch entity is owned by Reckitt Benckiser Group plc in the UK.

growth.text: Investing up to $600 million in US facilities in New Jersey and North Carolina to boost innovation and manufacturing.

worth_knowing.text: Its Mead Johnson unit won a federal trial over infant formula, after facing litigation about baby formula.
